source: Existing PyCBC adopted complex-SNR and trigger/veto criteria

sources.criteria: complex SNR absolute 0.001, zero relative tolerance; existing circular phase absolute 0.001 radians

scope: Apply these existing criteria to accepted stored triggers only. Other nonidentical floating fields remain unassessed. Derived complex SNR is snr * exp(i * coa_phase), evaluated in float64. This does not reproduce the full-time-series independent-oracle qualification required by the source document.
